name: exam-start-seal
intent: A locked exam surface unlocks when the central seal crack-strokes then splits into two halves that fly apart; timer starts on ACTIVE.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Panel appears ACTIVE with timer running; seal already removed; no crack or break motion

acceptance: Crack stroke draws over crackMs 160 (dash 80→0) before halves move
Halves translate to (−28,−18)/−28° and (28,18)/28° over breakMs 260 — not opacity fade as primary
On done, seal hidden and panel surface brightens over surfaceMs 220; timer starts at 00:00
Replay resets to LOCKED with intact seal and timer 00:00
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows ACTIVE immediately
